schedule_feasibility.method: Schedules constructed from each spec (weekly Monday 00:00Z for A5/A8 lanes and seeds; 28d cycle at 00:05Z for A6 lane) over the candidate scored window, plus a terminal FORCED_FLAT at 2026-08-21T00:05Z. Target books are REPRESENTATIVE SCHEDULE PROXIES: bucket membership from a deterministic, price-independent pseudo-characteristic (slow sinusoids), gross 1.0 dollar-neutral, weights 0.5/q (= the 1/(2*N_bucket) cap). NO scored return, PnL, factor or ranking exists anywhere in this audit. Fill prices are REAL staged 15m closes (first completed bar strictly after each decision) used as cost inputs only. Cost model declared at the frozen floors: taker_fee_bps=5.0 (= staged taker fee and V10 contract floor), adverse_tick_slip_floor=1, per-symbol tick sizes from staged instrument defs; stressed cell = frozen fee x1.5 / +2 ticks. All arithmetic reused verbatim from research.v11.cost_feasibility.evaluate_schedule_cost_feasibility and research.adapter_v10 - nothing forked.

min_eligible_symbols_per_decision.rule: PIT eligibility = exchange-listed (instrument onboardDate, all 20 listed long before window) AND required history (60d A5/A8-weekly, 90d A6/seeds from bar firsts) AND active (a bar within 48h before decision) AND trailing-28d median daily dollar volume strictly above the cross-sectional PIT median of active symbols (declared tradability floor).
min_eligible_symbols_per_decision.result: active = 20/20 at every decision date; above-median = 9 at every decision (min 9 / median 9 / max 9 across 52 weekly and 14 monthly dates). The DV-median floor structurally caps the universe near half the active names.
min_eligible_symbols_per_decision.breadth_assessment: VIABLE BREADTH THRESHOLD STATED: quintile books (A5/A8/seeds) run with 1 name per leg (floor(9/5)); tercile books run with 3 per leg. A6's declared fail-closed minimum of 6 names per leg requires >= 18 eligible symbols - UNSATISFIABLE on this snapshot (9 eligible < 18) and likely unsatisfiable on any ~20-symbol universe. Flag: weekly quintile families operate at extreme breadth (2 scored names per side); single-symbol concentration gates at Stage-A are the binding risk, HIGH severity, but not a pre-score floor failure.
min_eligible_symbols_per_decision.pit_listing_caveat: Staged bar firsts (2024-08-21..23 for all symbols) are snapshot-coverage starts, NOT exchange listing dates; PIT listing was therefore taken from the instrument-info onboardDate field (all <= 2023-12-31).
